sentences.text: Social worker Tom Okafor from Harbridge adult services visited Harold Pryce at his home, having been sent by Dr Bell.
Harold Pryce reported he has knee issues preventing him from maintaining his garden.
Harold reported he and Sandra have been married for nine years; Sandra is his second wife.
Harold reported his first wife, Joan, died in 2013.
Harold reported he had a fall in the garden in the spring.
Harold reported no falls since the spring incident.
Harold reported he can wash himself but sits on a stool in the shower.
Harold reported socks are a specific difficulty for him.
Harold reported he can make a sandwich.
Harold reported his wife Sandra cooks his meals.
Harold reported there is no toilet upstairs.
Harold reported Sandra keeps his medication in her handbag.
Harold reported he does not always take his medication; specifically, he missed his heart tablets for three days last week because Sandra kept them back.
Harold reported he has missed his water tablets as well.
Harold reported Carol never liked Sandra.
Harold expressed a wish for the abuse to stop and for his tablets to be taken.
Harold reported he bruises easily, attributing it to his tablets.
Harold disclosed that his wife Sandra hits him with her walking stick when she gets cross.
Harold stated Sandra hits him on his arms because he puts his arms up.
Harold reported the hitting occurs about once a week, or more frequently if Sandra has had a bad day.
Harold reported Sandra locks him in the bedroom when she goes out, claiming it is to prevent him from falling.
Harold reported Sandra locks him in the bedroom two or three times a week for the afternoon.
Harold reported he feels safe for the night as Sandra is going to her sister's the next day.
Harold reported his daughter Carol lives in Kestwick, approximately two hours away, and calls on Sundays.
Harold reported the house is in his name only, though Sandra claims she would take it if he left.
Harold reported he and Sandra bought the house in 1971.
Harold reported his pension goes into a joint account and Sandra does the bills.
Harold reported he has his own savings book at the post office.
Harold reported he has a mobile phone that Carol made him get.
Social worker Tom Okafor proposed raising a safeguarding concern with the team.
